Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Bănci
Our digital journey starts here! 
 Create. Grow. Deliver our story to millions. 
 #BTCode, where technology meets creativity. Code is our universal language and innovation is the fuel that propels us into the future. 🚀
 About the job 
 Most DevOps roles split you between on-prem and cloud, two different playbooks. At Banca Transilvania, we're building one: the same Git, CI/CD, container, and security pattern across OpenShift, AKS, EKS, and ECS.
 If you're looking for an open team with a strong focus on R&D and enablement, this is it. We're growing our Core DevOps team and looking for someone who'd rather fix the on-prem/cloud split than live with it: building, securing, and enabling the environments that power development and testing across the bank.
 How we work 
 On-prem and cloud aren't separate worlds here: one stack ships everywhere. You'll own environments end-to-end, commit to running workload, and help us finish migrating from Jenkins to GitHub Actions while we expand from Azure into AWS. We lean on automation, including AI-assisted tooling for root-cause work, so you're not stuck manually digging through logs.
 Objectives of this role 
Build, maintain, and secure the environments that support development and testing activities.
Enable teams to efficiently use both on-prem and cloud environments, accelerating technology adoption.
Collaborate with development and testing teams to continuously improve the software delivery lifecycle.
Collaborate with security teams to enforce DevSecOps and security best practices.
Collaborate with site resiliency teams to ensure proper maintenance, high availability, and disaster recovery readiness.
Own environments end-to-end and drive the Jenkins → GitHub Actions and Azure → AWS migrations.
 The stack 
 Git and CI/CD: Jenkins today, GitHub Actions next, plus Nexus and SonarQube.
 Scripting: Groovy, PowerShell, Shell/Bash.
 Containers and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS/EKS/ECS.
 Cloud identity and IaC: AWS (IAM, Terragrunt) and/or Azure (Managed Identities/RBAC, Key Vault, Terraform).
 Security: Kubernetes/container hardening, DevSecOps practices, private networking (VPC/VNet, private endpoints, site-to-site VPN).
 Required skills and qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Solid knowledge of Git and collaborative development workflows.
Solid knowledge of CI/CD principles and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube).
Solid scripting skills (Groovy, PowerShell, Shell/Bash).
Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration:
Docker and container image lifecycle management.
Kubernetes (deployments, networking, storage, RBAC, troubleshooting).
Helm for packaging and release management.
OpenShift platform operations and administration, plus production experience with at least one of OpenShift, EKS, ECS, or AKS.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes security and container platform hardening.
Hands on experience with AWS / Azure
Professional English; Romanian for local team collaboration.
 Nice to have / considered an advantage 
GitOps and delivery orchestration tools (Argo CD, Argo Workflows).
Secrets management solutions (HashiCorp Vault).
Workflow/process orchestration tools (Camunda).
Observability and monitoring platforms (Grafana, Dynatrace, Prometheus/ELK).
Production experience with AWS / Azure
Relevant certifications: KCNA, CKA / CKAD / CKS, or an equivalent AWS/Azure cloud certification.
IaC with Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible
Curiosity about AI-assisted ops / agentic automation.
Previous experience in large enterprises or financial institutions.
 What we offer 
A live migration to shape — Jenkins to GitHub Actions, Azure to AWS.
A growing, R&D-minded team distributed across major Romanian cities.
Collaboration with cross-functional teams to improve existing solutions and deliver new capabilities.
The opportunity to innovate and see your ideas implemented at scale.
No on-call rotation.
Colleagues who care about the craft, not the ticket queue.
 If you want to find out what other jobs we still have available, like Life at BT or what #Culture BT is, you can also access the Bank's career website : https://cariere.bancatransilvania.ro/ 
 So, ready to venture into this technological journey?
